verdict.rationale: Guidance content on www.uscis.gov (file-online, filing-fees, tools, G-28 pages) appears in the evidence pack as quoted text, and the probe notes that www.uscis.gov's Crawl-delay was honored, so its robots.txt was evidently readable. However, the same host returned HTTP 403 to a standard pipeline UA at /llms.txt. The egov.uscis.gov host also serves a Cloudflare challenge even at robots.txt, so keyless agent access is inconsistent across the public surface. Missing for 10: a direct probe confirming guidance pages return 200 to an identified keyless agent, absence of 403 or bot-wall responses on www paths, a reachable agent-oriented index (llms.txt), and confirmation that no JS-only shell or CAPTCHA fronts the reading surface.
